name: Amino acid metabolism spanning proline, glycine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid (and glyoxylate/amide) metabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from the threonine/citrulline/organic-acid neighbours, and proline/glycine/glyoxylate separate it from the phenylalanine/PKU neighbour.

name: Transcriptional control and restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern myeloid progenitor and granulocyte/monocyte/macrophage differentiation under transcriptional regulators (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis TFs) and negative regulation, whereas confusables carry positive regulation and mature neutrophil/monocyte programs.

name: Chondrocyte development and embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: All members are chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation/hypertrophy or cartilage/joint morphogenesis; joint and cartilage morphogenesis distinguish it from ossification/tendon and articular-cartilage-homeostasis neighbours.

core: Cytosolic calcium handling in striated muscle
qualifier: ryanodine-receptor release, calcium clearance and cardiac relaxation
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release and clearance in cardiac relaxation
rationale: Members regulate sarcoplasmic calcium release and its removal (Na/Ca exchange) to control contraction, relaxation and heart rate, with negative regulation of contraction and rate distinguishing it from the positive-inotropy and SERCA-uptake neighbours.

qualifier: melanin synthesis, differentiation and light response
name: Melanocyte melanin synthesis, differentiation and light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programs, melanin and pigment granule processes and melanocyte growth; melanin biosynthesis, UV-A/blue light responses and melanocyte differentiation distinguish it from the MITF cell-cycle/melanosome-assembly neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation of contraction and heart rate
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, adaptation and positive contractile regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, survival and regeneration plus enhanced contraction and heart rate, which separates it from smooth-muscle neighbours and from the calcineurin/cell-size neighbour.

name: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern GPCR-driven cAMP production (including forskolin) and PKA activation, while neighbours carry adenylate cyclase inhibition or downstream CREB, PDE and cAMP catabolism.

qualifier: oocyte maturation through luteinization and luteolysis
name: Ovarian cycle from oocyte maturation to luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle, whereas confusables are centred on gonadotropin secretion and response.

core: Inherited imino acid and glycine transport defects
name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline and glycine transporters
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, distinct from the hexose, urate, cystinuria and Hartnup neighbours.

core: ER protein targeting and membrane insertion
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER plus COPII cargo export to the Golgi, which neighbours lack (they emphasize folding, ERAD or COPI traffic).

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are craniofacial (palate, nose, viscero/neurocranium) and limb/digit morphogenesis with mesenchymal development, distinguishing it from pharyngeal-gland and ossification neighbours.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 and cytokine production with STING activation
rationale: Members regulate CCL5 and other chemokine/dendritic-cell cytokine production together with cGAMP import and cGAS-STING activation, which separates it from TLR7-9, IL-12/Th1 and macrophage-chemokine neighbours.

name: Centrosome microtubule organization and spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and astral spindle orientation and localization, which distinguish it from mitotic-centrosome recruitment and cytokinesis neighbours.

name: COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde targeting
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER/Golgi vesicle targeting, distinguishing it from COPII-export and tethering neighbours.

core: Endosomal recycling to the plasma membrane
name: Endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane delivery
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling to the surface plus Golgi export and vesicular cholesterol transport, which neighbours lack (they emphasize endosome-to-Golgi retrograde or constitutive secretion).

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis and retinoid disorders
name: Retinol and retinoic acid metabolism and its disorders
rationale: All members are vitamin A/retinoid (diterpenoid) metabolism, transport or retinoid disease; disease events distinguish it from the RA-response and vitamin D neighbours and RA biosynthesis from the visual-cycle neighbour.

name: Solute carrier transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated plasma membrane transport and its inherited defects, dominated by neutral/imino amino acids and peptides with urate, distinguishing it from hexose, organic cation and cationic amino acid neighbours.

qualifier: negative regulation of myogenesis and atrophy
name: Restraint of myogenic differentiation and skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: Members negatively regulate myoblast/myotube differentiation and muscle development, maintain satellite cells and drive inactivity-induced atrophy, whereas neighbours carry pro-myogenic, contractile or hypertrophy programs.

name: Glycogen metabolism and dietary hexose absorption
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases plus disaccharide digestion and hexose transport, distinguishing it from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, galactose and urate neighbours.

name: RUNX2- and Wnt-regulated osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt and BMP signals and mechanical load, distinguishing it from chondrocyte, collagen/tendon and osteoclast neighbours.

name: M-CSF-driven macrophage proliferation and osteoclast differentiation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/interleukin signaling, macrophage proliferation and fusion, and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, which neighbours (GM-CSF, monocyte/DC differentiation) lack.

name: Golgi ribbon dynamics and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members are Golgi disassembly/reassembly, ribbon formation, positioning and vesicle budding with membrane tubulation, distinguishing it from secretory-traffic and COPI-transport neighbours.

qualifier: integrin and fibronectin in fibroblast migration
name: Fibroblast integrin-fibronectin adhesion and migration
rationale: Members cover focal adhesion assembly, integrin synthesis, fibronectin matrix and SRF-driven cytoskeletal remodelling in fibroblast migration, separating it from EMT, syndecan and collagen-receptor neighbours.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome-to-surface recycling, constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane localization, distinguishing it from endosome-to-Golgi, lysosomal and Rab/ARF neighbours.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz inhibitory signaling
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz control of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members are GPCR pathways regulating adenylate cyclase, mainly inhibitory alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz signaling, distinguishing it from catecholamine-secretion, cAMP/PKA and muscarinic/purinergic neighbours.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere capping and recombination/replication-based maintenance with DNA unwinding, break-induced replication and resolution of recombination intermediates, which neighbours lack.

qualifier: chain-type ubiquitination, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain synthesis, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
rationale: Most members are linkage-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly/degradation, distinguishing it from neddylation and autophagy/ERAD quality-control neighbours.

qualifier: nephron segment patterning and nephric duct
name: Nephron segment patterning and nephric duct development
rationale: Members cover nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric nephron tubule morphogenesis and segment patterning, while neighbours center on ureteric bud induction and kidney size.

name: Bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members are heme degradation, hepatic organic anion uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export of bilirubin and their defects, distinguishing it from drug ADME/xenobiotic neighbours.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
qualifier: activating and inhibitory NK receptors including MHC class Ib
name: Receptor-mediated tuning of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity through NK surface receptors and MHC class Ib recognition, with negative regulation distinguishing it from granzyme, KIR-cluster and T-cell proliferation neighbours.
